<tr><td>

[MusicClient](./music_contract.musicclient.md)

</td><td>

The Music client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `musicContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [MusicResources](./music_contract.musicresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

</td></tr>

<tr><td>

[MusicResources](./music_contract.musicresources.md)

</td><td>

The type of the resource table in `musicContract` (the app's `/contract` entry): every resource a reference can name, keyed by manifest resource key, with its record type, its identifier type (when it has one), the operations that resolve references to it, and, for each of those operations that finds the resource only within another resource, that parent. A client created from the contract carries it, so `bindReference` admits only references the contract can resolve.

</td></tr>
